verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. In both, the original story layout has been shrunk into a narrow band in the middle of the tall skyscraper canvas. That leaves large dead white areas above and below, which reads as a scaled-down copy rather than a rearranged design. The 'Your personal' and 'MUSINA.FR' text is tiny, and the photo, the dark panels and the yellow bar stay crammed together while most of the canvas sits empty.
